g.text: The trees stand shoulder to shoulder here; there is no way through.
A wet, green-slick figure hauls itself over the roots — an utopiec, far from its
The wilk slams into you, and you taste blood and old leaves.
Your blow bites into the wilk; it recoils with a wet hiss. The wilk rakes you
with crooked claws; pain flares hot along your ribs. The wilk lunges — you twist
away, its claws snapping shut on nothing.
The wilk slams into you, and you taste blood and old leaves.
The wilk circles and comes at you again, patient as winter. The bies rakes you
with crooked claws; pain flares hot along your ribs.
